tasks.title: The test gate gets back at least 12 seconds of headroom so the heavy-ship phase fits under its time ceiling
tasks.description: Gate room before any Phase 10 code lands (plan §2.15). GUT was about 225 s at the Phase 9 close against the 240 s ceiling; this phase's allotments total 21.5 s. Profile with scripts/gate-time.sh (15 slowest files, two runs), then recover time only by the tests/README.md rules: real-physics rows on the 8x clock, replays computed once and shared (before_all / memo keyed by inputs), per-tick bookkeeping no assertion reads dropped, or a bit-identical production speed-up (the Phase 8 t1 FighterBrain.tick precedent). Never lower a tick count, duration, sample count or start grid, widen a bound or remove an assertion. Record before / after (two runs each) and the Phase 10 allotments and noise rule in tests/README.md -> Gate time.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- Mean of two scripts/gate-time.sh GUT Time runs is at least 12 s below the mean of two before runs (target 15 s), with the same test count and every test passing.
- scripts/check-test-leaks.sh is clean.
- tests/README.md has the before / after rows, the Phase 10 allotment line (t2 2.0, t3 0.8, t4 3.5, t5 2.5, t6 2.0, t7 1.8, t8 2.2, t9 0.4, t10 0.8, t11 3.0, t12 2.5, t13 0) and the noise rule (two-run mean; escalate past 237 s or past 1.5x a task's own allotment).
- If 12 s cannot be found without breaking a rule, the run ends with Result: ESCALATE and the profile.
